notes: A short list of proven single skills. Every entry is one skill folder on GitHub with real use (install counts or stars) or a builder with a record, useful to a normal AI user, and checked for malicious code (piped-shell installs, credential reads, obfuscated code) in the files it installs; re-checked whenever those files change. `checked.date` is the latest scan. Provided as-is - read anything before you run it.

pain_points.label: Answers are long and the next step is buried
Answers are hard to follow or understand
Writing sounds like AI or falls flat
Your AI charges ahead before the plan is clear
Long chats get slow, forgetful, or costly
You want to learn something, not just get answers
Pages and apps your AI builds look generic
Your AI says “done” when tests are weak or missing
Code works but is over-built or hard to change
Your AI ignores your instructions; the setup is cluttered
